name: guidance
description: Evidence-ranked UI design rules for Claude: sets up design tokens, spacing density and corner shape in any stack, then builds, reviews and fixes interfaces against WCAG 2.2, Material 3, Apple, Baymard, GOV.UK and NN/g, and checks code or a live page against every WCAG 2.2 A and AA criterion. Not a UI kit.

setup.content:
Run the GUIdance `setup` command. Read `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/guidance/SKILL.md`, then `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/guidance/commands/setup.md`, and follow it. Paths in those files are relative to `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/guidance/`. You are running as a plugin: write any GUIdance command you suggest as `/guidance:<command>` (for example `/guidance:fix`), not `/guidance <command>`.

Arguments: $ARGUMENTS
setup.description: Set up design tokens: colour roles, density and shape, in your stack's format
